name: Vesper, the Star-Script Witch
description: Modelled in code from the concept sheets: every part is a signed distance field meshed through OpenVDB, cloth is one sheet thickened in Blender, the face is the head sheet's own drawing projected onto the skull. A Mixamo-named skeleton (so Emberfox's takes can be retargeted) with three bones in every finger and thumb, plus bones for the hat cone, its star, four hair locks and the book.
spell_effects: Godot BattleFX nodes, never part of the mesh; her hands are kept clear for casting.
